build_eomt_image_processor: build an EomtImageProcessor instance for preprocessing images and segmentation maps for the EoMT model
preprocess_eomt_images: preprocess input images and optional segmentation maps into batched pixel values with patch offsets for EoMT
merge_image_patches: merge overlapping image patch segmentation logits back into full-size segmentation maps for reconstruction
post_process_semantic_segmentation: post-process EoMT model outputs into final semantic segmentation predictions with resized class maps
post_process_panoptic_segmentation: post-process EoMT model outputs into panoptic segmentation results with per-pixel class and segment assignments
